# Read dataset, summarize data for each CoupleID and add nessesary information

```{r}

## Read data
data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "Combined_dataset_Europe.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

## Convert as factor
data <- data  |> 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(PetriNumber = as.factor(PetriNumber)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID = as.factor(CoupleID))

##Summarize data for each CoupleID (1053 rows)
merged_data <- data |>
  dplyr::group_by(CoupleID, CrossType, Female, Male, Batch, Block, Year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(sum_eggcount_corr = sum(EggCountCorr),
                   sum_larvacount = sum(LarvaeCount))

## Compute hatch rate for each CoupleID
merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(hatchrate = sum_larvacount / sum_eggcount_corr)

# Add nessesary information to the data frame
# Add column female and male infection status
## Define infected and uninfected categories
infected_categories <- c("Tok3", "Tok10", "T11", "Wat148", "Wat140", "Par6", "Day28", "Sap24", "Bal", "SFL", "Day58", "Rennes", "Trento", "Kor", "China", "Am^Bal", "Am^Trento", "Am^Rennes", "Am^Par6")
uninfected_categories <- c("Am", "Tok18", "Day80", "Wat120", "Mon47", "Par7", "BalT", "RennesT", "TrentoT", "Sap11")

## Apply the function to both females and males
merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::mutate (FemaleInfect = get_infection_status(Female, infected_categories, uninfected_categories)) |>
  dplyr::mutate (MaleInfect = get_infection_status(Male, infected_categories, uninfected_categories))

## Check the infection status of each strain is assigned
merged_data[is.na(merged_data$FemaleInfect),]

# Add column description of cross
merged_data <- merged_data |>
dplyr::mutate(Cross = as.factor(determine_cross(MaleInfect, FemaleInfect)))|>
dplyr:: mutate(Cross = factor(Cross, levels = c("Control cross 1 W- x W-", "Test cross W- x W+", "Control cross 2 W+ x W-", "Control cross 3 W+ x W+")))

# Add information about number of Couples For each CrossType
##Count the number of couples per CrossType
cross_count <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Couple_count = dplyr::n())

##Create a new label combining CrossType and the number of Couples
cross_count <- cross_count %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = paste0(CrossType, " " ,"(", Couple_count, ")" ))

## Merge the new labels with the data
merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(cross_count, by = "CrossType")

## Export file with hatch rates per Couple_ID
write.table(x = merged_data, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

```

# Fit one zero-inflated GLMM with merged_data
```{r}

# Subset the data with a single type of cross (with Bal line)
dat <- merged_data[merged_data$Female%in%c("Am", "Bal")&merged_data$Male%in%c("Am", "Bal"), ]

datCrossType <- dat |>
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Sum_eggcount_corr = sum(sum_eggcount_corr),
                   Sum_larvacount = sum(sum_larvacount))|>
  dplyr::mutate(hatchrate = Sum_larvacount / Sum_eggcount_corr)

## Fit null model
m0 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ 1 , data=dat, ziformula=~1 , family=binomial)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m0)
summary(m0)

## Zero-inflated part of the model
unique(predict(m0, type="zprob"))

## Hatch rate
unique(predict(m0, type="conditional"))

## Combined probability (1-prob_no_mating) x hatch rate
unique(predict(m0, type="response"))

## Probability of having no mating
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m0)$zi)))

## Hatch rate
(p2 <-1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m0)$cond)))

##Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
sum(dat$sum_larvacount)/sum(dat$sum_eggcount_corr)

## cross type effect on hatch rate
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1 + CrossType + (1| CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~ 1 , family=binomial)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m1)
summary(m1)

## Probability of having no mating
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m1)$zi)))

## Hatch rate
(p2 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m1)$cond)))

##Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
datCrossType$hatchrate

## cross type effect on hatch rate and mating probability
m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ 1 + (1| CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~ -1 + CrossType , family=binomial)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m2)
logLik(m2)

## Probability of having no mating
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m2)$zi)))

## Hatch rate
(p2 <-1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m2)$cond)))

##Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
datCrossType$hatchrate

## cross type effect on hatch rate and mating probability
dat$prop <- dat$sum_larvacount / dat$sum_eggcount_corr
m3 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount)~ -1 + CrossType + (1| CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~ -1 + CrossType , family=binomial, control=glmmTMB::glmmTMBControl(optCtrl=list(iter.max=1e4, eval.max=1e4)))
#m3 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop~ -1 + CrossType + (1| CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~ -1 + CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m3)
summary(m3)
logLik(m3)
## Probability of having no mating
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m3)$zi)))

## Hatch rate
(p2 <-1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m3)$cond)))

## CI estimate
1-p2[2]/p2[3]

##Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
datCrossType$hatchrate

MuMIn::AICc(m0, m1, m2, m3)
MuMIn::model.sel(m0, m1, m2, m3)

## Compute confidence interval for m3
## Refit model nsim times
b1 <- lme4::bootMer(m3, FUN=extract_model, nsim=500, .progress="txt")
  
## Extract all CIs
confint <- bCI_tab(b=b1)

```

# Fit each zero-inflated GLMM with merged data and account for nonindependence for CoupleID 
```{r}
## Example for one cross
AmBal <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "Bal"), data=merged_data)

AmTrento <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "Trento"), data=merged_data)

AmRennes <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "Rennes"), data=merged_data)

AmPar6 <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "Par6"), data=merged_data)

```

# Fit each zero-inflated GLMM with merged data for Bal, Trento, Par6 and Rennes lines 
```{r}
## List of lines
europe <- unique(merged_data$Male[merged_data$Female=="Am"&merged_data$Male!="Am"])
europe <- europe[c(1, 2, 3, 11)]

## Dataframe with all the lines
crosses <- data.frame(continent=rep("Europe", 4), uninf_strain="Am" , inf_strain=c("Trento", "Bal", "Rennes", "Par6"))

## Fit all models on all the crosses function with nbootsim = 500
results <- apply(crosses, 1, fit_ZIBinomial, nbootsim = 100)

## Extract the results from all models
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)

confintp1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp1"))

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

CI <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintCI"))

## Export files
write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "model_AICc.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

write.table(x = confintp1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp1.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = CI, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CI_estimates.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

```

# Figure 1
```{r}

#Read database
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=",", header = TRUE))

# Filter and keep data only for screen for CI (403 rows)
data1 <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("AmxAm", "BalxBal", "AmxBal", "BalxAm", "TrentoxTrento", "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "RennesxAm", "AmxRennes", "RennesxRennes", "AmxPar6","Par6xPar6", "Par6xAm"))

# Combine all CrossTypes for one Pair
data1 <- data1 |>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = dplyr::case_when(
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm") ~ "Control",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "TrentoxTrento") ~ "Trento",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxBal", "BalxAm", "BalxBal") ~ "Bal",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxRennes", "RennesxAm", "RennesxRennes") ~ "Rennes",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxPar6","Par6xAm", "Par6xPar6") ~ "Par6",TRUE ~ NA_character_ ))

data1 <- data1 |>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = factor(Pair, levels = c("Control", "Trento", "Bal", "Par6", "Rennes")))

# Plot hatch_rate
data1 |>
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

#Read data with median hatch rate estimation from the model
data_hatchrate <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2.csv"), sep=",", header = TRUE))

data_hatchrate <- data_hatchrate |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = sub(".*CrossType", "", type))

data_hatchrate <- data_hatchrate |>
dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Add information about hatch rate to the dataset
median_hatch_rate <- dplyr::left_join(x=data_hatchrate, y=data1[, c("CoupleID", "CrossType", "CrossTypeLabel", "hatchrate","Female", "Male", "Pair", "Cross", "Batch", "Block", "Year")], by = "CrossType")

median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr:: filter(!is.na(CrossTypeLabel))

#Change order for the CrosstypesLabel
desired_order2 <- c(
    "AmxAm (76)", 
    "AmxTrento (41)", "TrentoxAm (34)", "TrentoxTrento (43)",
    "AmxBal (46)", "BalxAm (30)","BalxBal (31)",
    "AmxRennes (29)", "RennesxAm (20)", "RennesxRennes (27)",
    "AmxPar6 (13)", "Par6xAm (14)", "Par6xPar6 (26)")

median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = factor(CrossTypeLabel, levels = desired_order2))

# Remove the same CrossTypes (13 rows left)
median_hatch_rate_reduced <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

median_hatch_rate <-median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr::mutate(Year = as.factor(Year))

#Create bar plot with individual data points

hatchrateplot1 <- median_hatch_rate_reduced |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = Estimate, fill = Cross), size=100) +
  ggplot2::geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(ggplot2::aes(ymin = X2.50., ymax = X97.50.), width = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = median_hatch_rate, aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate, color = Year), position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), size =3) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c ("2023" = "#931F1D", "2024" = "#00008B")) +

  #ggh4x::facet_nested(~Pair, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  ggh4x::facet_nested(~Pair, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  #ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ LineType + Pair_Type, ncol = 4, scales = "free_x", strip.position = "top", drop=FALSE, labeller = label_bquote( cols = Pair_Type)) +
  ##ggplot2::facet_grid(Continent~Pair, switch = NULL, scales = "free", space = "fixed") +

        legend.title = element_text(size = 30),
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.text.x = element_text(size =45),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey")) + # text for the subtitles/strips
        theme(
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),

          )

#save bar plot

cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
```

# Fit zero-inflated GLMM with for introgressed lines Am^Bal, Am^Trento, Am^Par6 and Am^Rennes for Batch 6 and Batch 7

```{r}

#Fit all zero-inflated models for introgression experiment for Batch6 and Batch 7 only
##Filter data for Bal, L6 and Rennes only for Batch 6 nad 7 (415 rows)
merged_data_batch67 <- merged_data |>
 dplyr::filter(Batch == 6 | Batch == 7)

## Dataframe with all the strains
crosses <- data.frame(continent=rep("europe", 8), uninf_strain="Am" , inf_strain=c("Trento", "Bal", "Rennes", "Par6", "Am^Trento", "Am^Bal", "Am^Rennes", "Am^Par6"))

results <- apply(crosses, 1,
  function(x) {
    fit_ZIBinomial(
      crosses = x,
      data = merged_data_batch67,
      nbootsim = 500)})

## Extract the results from all models
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_intr_Batch67.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "model_AICc_intr_Batch67.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

#For itrogressed lines best model age only intercept. To measure hatch rate diffferrent models were used
#Read database with hatch rate
datai <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_intr_Batch67.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

##Remove rows for "Am^Trento", "Am^Bal", "Am^Rennes", "Am^Par6"
datai<- datai |>
dplyr::filter(!infstrain %in% c("Am^Trento", "Am^Bal", "Am^Rennes", "Am^Par6"))

# Fit model m1 for Am^Trento
dat <- merged_data_batch67 |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Female %in% c("Am", "Am^Trento"),
      Male %in% c("Am", "Am^Trento"))

res_trento <- run_hatchrate_ci(
  data = merged_data_batch67,
  uninfstrain = "Am",
  infstrain = "Am^Trento",
  nsim = 500,
  model = "m1",
  seed = 1
)

attr(res_trento, "p2")
attr(res_trento, "model")

# Fit model m1 for Am^Bal

dat <- merged_data_batch67 |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Female %in% c("Am", "Am^Bal"),
      Male %in% c("Am", "Am^Bal"))

res_bal <- run_hatchrate_ci(
  data = merged_data_batch67,
  uninfstrain = "Am",
  infstrain = "Am^Bal",
  nsim = 100,
  model = "m1",
  seed = 1
)

attr(res_bal, "p2")
attr(res_bal, "model")

# Fit model m1 for Am^Rennes

dat <- merged_data_batch67 |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Female %in% c("Am", "Am^Rennes"),
      Male %in% c("Am", "Am^Rennes"))

res_ren <- run_hatchrate_ci(
  data = merged_data_batch67,
  uninfstrain = "Am",
  infstrain = "Am^Rennes",
  nsim = 100,
  model = "m1",
  seed = 1
)

attr(res_bal, "p2")
attr(res_bal, "model")

# Fit model m1 for Am^Par6

dat <- merged_data_batch67 |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Female %in% c("Am", "Am^Par6"),
      Male %in% c("Am", "Am^Par6"))

res_par <- run_hatchrate_ci(
  data = merged_data_batch67,
  uninfstrain = "Am",
  infstrain = "Am^Par6",
  nsim = 100,
  model = "m1",
  seed = 1
)

attr(res_bal, "p2")
attr(res_bal, "model")

datai2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(datai, res_trento, res_bal, res_ren, res_par)

 
#Save full dataset for experiment with introgressed lines
write.table(x = datai2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_intr_Batch_67_full.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Fit models with Trento, Rennes, L6, Bal lines + tetr only for Batch5

```{r}

crosses <- data.frame(continent=rep("europe", 6), uninf_strain="Am" , inf_strain=c("Trento", "Bal", "Rennes", "TrentoT", "BalT", "RennesT"))

results <- apply(crosses, 1,
  function(x) {
    fit_ZIBinomial(
      crosses = x,
      data = merged_data_batch5,
      nbootsim = 100)})

## Extract the results from all models
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_Tet_Batch5.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "model_AICc_Tet_Batch5.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

# Fit one zero-inflated GLMM with for BalT, TrentoT and Rennes lines

#Read database with hatch rate and CI
datat <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_Tet_Batch5.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

#Remove rows for BalT, TrentoT and Rennes
datat<- datat |>
dplyr::filter(!infstrain %in% c("BalT", "TrentoT", "Rennes"))

# Fit model m1 for BalT
##Subset the data with a single type of cross
dat <- merged_data_batch5[merged_data_batch5$Female%in%c("Am", "BalT")&merged_data_batch5$Male%in%c("Am", "BalT"), ]

## Fit m1 model to measure hatch rate
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + CrossType + (1| CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~ 1 , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m1)
summary(m1)

## Hatch rate
(p2 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m1)$cond)))

## Refit model nsim times
  b1 <- lme4::bootMer(m1, FUN=extract_model, nsim=100, .progress="txt")
  
  ##Confidence intervals estimation
  confint <- bCI_tab(b=b1)
  
  ##Extract data
  confintp2 <- confint[grepl("cond", rownames(confint)),]
  
  confintp2 <- as.data.frame(confintp2) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "type")
  
  ##Change format of the data for BalT
  confintp2full <- confintp2 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    continent   = "europe",
    uninfstrain = "Am",
    infstrain   = "BalT",
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    continent, uninfstrain, infstrain,
    type, Estimate, `2.5 %`, `97.5 %`
  )|>
  dplyr::rename(
    X2.5.  = `2.5 %`,
    X97.5. = `97.5 %`
  )
  
#Fit model m3 for TrentoT
##Subset the data with a single type of cross 
dat2 <- merged_data_batch5[merged_data_batch5$Female%in%c("Am", "TrentoT")&merged_data_batch5$Male%in%c("Am", "TrentoT"), ]

## Fit model m3 for TrentoT
  m3 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate~ -1 + CrossType + (1| CoupleID), data=dat2, ziformula=~ -1 + CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
  
  ## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m3)
summary(m3)

## Hatch rate
(p2 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m3)$cond)))

## Refit model nsim times
  b1 <- lme4::bootMer(m3, FUN=extract_model, nsim=100, .progress="txt")
  
  ##Confidence intervals estimation

  #Fit model m1 for Rennes
```

```{r}
      "AmxAm^Rennes", "Am^RennesxAm","Am^RennesxAm^Rennes")) ##267 rows

  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Couple_count = dplyr::n())

##Create a new label combining CrossType and the number of Couples

  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = paste0(CrossType, " " ,"(", Couple_count, ")" ))

## Merge the new labels with the data

## Create an order

      "AmxAm", 
      "AmxAm^Trento", "Am^TrentoxAm","Am^TrentoxAm^Trento",
      "AmxAm^Bal", "Am^BalxAm","Am^BalxAm^Bal",

      "AmxAm^Rennes", "Am^RennesxAm","Am^RennesxAm^Rennes"
   )

  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = factor(CrossType, levels = desired_order))

  dplyr::mutate(Pair = dplyr::case_when(
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm") ~ "Control",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_ ))
```

```{r}
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)
##crossnum <- 1:2
confintp1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp1"))

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

CI <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintCI"))

## Export files
write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "model_AICc_Batch.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

write.table(x = confintp1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp1_Batch.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_Batch.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = CI, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CI_estimates_Batch.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
m3_simres <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m3)
plot(m3_simres)

car::Anova(m3,type="III")

## Confidence interval for p1 and p2
1/(1+exp(-confint(m3, parm=NULL, estimate = TRUE, component="all", method="Wald")))

## Confidence interval for p1
emmeans::emmeans(m3, ~ CrossType, component = "zi", type = "response")

## Confidence interval for p2
emmp2 <- emmeans::emmeans(m3, ~ CrossType, component = "cond", type = "response")

## Confidence interval for (1-p1)*p2
emmeans::emmeans(m3, ~ CrossType, component = "response")

pairs(emmp2, adjust = "tukey")
(1-p2[2])/(1-p2[1])
coefp2 <- glmmTMB::fixef(m3)$cond
exp(coefp2[1]-coefp2[2])
```

# Fit zero-inflated GLMM without merged data (not for publication)
```{r}
## TODO: - Add flip (or male age) to the model 
##       - Add number of eggs to the model (ie test for trade off between quantity and quality)

# Subset the data with a single type of cross
dat <- data[data$Female%in%c("Am", "Bal")&data$Male%in%c("Am", "Bal"), ]
dim(dat)
#dat <- data[data$Female%in%c("Am", "Trento")&data$Male%in%c("Am", "Trento"), ]
#dat <- data[data$Female%in%c("Am", "Rennes")&data$Male%in%c("Am", "Rennes"), ]
#dat <- data[data$Female%in%c("Am", "L6")&data$Male%in%c("Am", "L6"), ]

#dat <- data[data$CrossType=="AmxL6", ]
#dat <- data[data$CrossType=="W120xW120", ]
#dat <- data[data$CrossType=="W148xW120", ]
#dat <- data[data$CrossType=="Sok28xSok28", ]
#dat[dat$LarvaeCount==0&dat$CrossType=="TrentoxTrento",]

dat %>%
  dplyr::mutate(hatch_rate=LarvaeCount/EggCountCorr) |>
  #dplyr::group_by(CoupleID, CrossType, Female, Male, Batch, Block, Year) |>
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType, Female, Male) |>
  dplyr::summarize(sample_size=dplyr::n(), mean_hatch_rate=mean(hatch_rate), median_hatch_rate=median(hatch_rate))


## Fit null model
m0 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr-LarvaeCount) ~ 1 + (1|CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~1 + (1|CoupleID), family=binomial)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m0)
summary(m0)

## Zero-inflated part of the model
unique(predict(m0, type="zprob"))

## Hatch rate
unique(predict(m0, type="conditional"))

## Combined probability (1-prob_no_mating) x hatch rate
unique(predict(m0, type="response"))

## Probability of having no mating
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m0)$zi)))

## Hatch rate
(p2 <-1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m0)$cond)))

##Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
sum(dat$LarvaeCount)/sum(dat$EggCountCorr)

## cross type effect on hatch rate
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr-LarvaeCount) ~ -1 + CrossType + (1|CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~ 1 + (1|CoupleID), family=binomial)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m1)
summary(m1)

## Probability of having no mating
p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m1)$zi))

## Hatch rate
p2 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m1)$cond))

##Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
datCrossType$hatchrate

## cross type effect on hatch rate and mating rate (= complete CI?)
m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr-LarvaeCount) ~ 1 + CrossType + (1|CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~ 1 + CrossType + (1|CoupleID), family=binomial)

## Check the model
#glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m2)
summary(m2)

## Probability of having no mating
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m2)$zi)))

## Hatch rate
(p2 <-1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m2)$cond)))

## Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
datCrossType$hatchrate

MuMIn::AICc(m0, m1, m2)

glmmTMB::ranef(m2)$cond$CoupleID


## cross type effect on hatch rate and mating probability
m3 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr-LarvaeCount) ~ -1 + CrossType + (1|CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~ -1 + CrossType + (1|CoupleID), family=binomial)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m3)
summary(m3)

## Probability of having no mating
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m3)$zi)))

## Hatch rate
(p2 <-1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m3)$cond)))

## CI estimate
1-p2[2]/p2[3]

##Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
datCrossType$hatchrate

MuMIn::AICc(m0, m1, m2, m3)
MuMIn::model.sel(m0, m1, m2, m3)

```

# Old code
```{r, eval=FALSE}

##  Simulate new datasets from the fitted model, and calculate residuals by comparing the observed data to the new data
## residuals are calculated conditional on all random effects using re.form = NULL  
simulationOutput <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(fittedModel = m2, refit = FALSE, re.form = NULL, seed = 12, n = 1000)

## We expect the distribution of residuals to be uniform
hist(residuals(simulationOutput))

## qq-plot to detect overall deviations from the expected distribution
DHARMa::plotQQunif(simulationOutput)

## Plot of the residuals against the predicted value (regression of the empirical 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75 quantiles)
DHARMa::plotResiduals(simulationOutput)

## Test for overdispersion
DHARMa::testDispersion(simulationOutput, type = c("DHARMa", "PearsonChisq"))

## Test for zero-inflation
DHARMa::testZeroInflation(simulationOutput)

# often useful to test dispersion per group (in particular for binomial data, see vignette)
simulationOutputAggregated = DHARMa::recalculateResiduals(simulationOutput, group = data$CrossType)
DHARMa::testDispersion(simulationOutputAggregated)

m3 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
  cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr) ~ 1 + Flip + (1 | CoupleID), 
  data = dat, 
  ziformula = ~ -1 + CrossType, 
  family = binomial
)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m3)
summary(m3)

```
